item.title: [Itrfoundation] Amendment One, Iowa’s Budget, and the Importance of Priorities
item.description:
Iowans are starting to hear a lot of noise surrounding Amendment One. The amendment, which would require a two-thirds vote of the Iowa Legislature to increase income taxes, is on the ballot for the November 3 election. Some of the debate centers on what that higher threshold could mean for priorities such as education and health care. Fortunately, Iowa’s recent experience provides some answers. Even as lawmakers have repeatedly reduced income tax rates, state spending on both education and health care has continued to grow.
